<!-- Use a Conventional Commit title: fix(scope): describe the change.
For breaking changes, use ! and explain migration in a BREAKING CHANGE: footer
in the final squash commit. See CONTRIBUTING.md. -->

## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the affected guide or journal
entry and the implementation where useful.

## Validation

List commands and outcomes. State separately what was built, tested on the host,
installed, and observed on a physical device. Identify any skipped or blocked checks.

## Evidence and inputs

For relevant changes, include reviewed screenshots or recordings, source/artifact
identities, dependency pins, fixtures, and a way to reproduce the result. Explain
performance workloads, sampling, and limitations.

## Review notes

- [ ] I reviewed the diff, new files, and applicable privacy/media checks.
- [ ] I preserved upstream attribution and identified imported material's terms.
- [ ] I updated relevant documentation and build/test inputs.
- [ ] I identified remaining gaps and any hardware or deployment actions still needed.

- [ ] I identified applicable license terms and, where required, supplied a separate explicit contributor agreement acceptance for these exact changes (this checkbox is not that acceptance).
